fixtures.title: Subtly false proof with boundary sign error caught by independent refutation
fixtures.rationale: A polished proof containing a boundary sign error cannot corroborate without a refutation attempt and must transition to disputed/refuted when independent counterevidence lands.

fixtures.title: Formally compiling artifact proving a weaker statement than claimed (statement-equivalence trap)
fixtures.rationale: Proof evidence cannot cure a statement defect; a statement-defect finding forces malformed, removes machine-checked badge, and only new-version exits malformed.

fixtures.title: Finite-domain computation (n <= 100) claimed as universal theorem
fixtures.rationale: Universal quantifiers backed solely by finite-domain checks must be flagged as scope-mismatched.

input.claim_statement: For all positive integers n, f(n) < n^2.

fixtures.title: Unanchored citation with no DOI, arXiv ID, URL, or verbatim quote
fixtures.rationale: Literature assertions without a verifiable anchor or source locator are refused as unanchored.

fixtures.title: Misquoted citation failing does-the-source-say-that verification
fixtures.rationale: A quoted claim not supported by the anchored source excerpt must be flagged rather than accepted.

input.quoted_text: Theorem 3 proves unconditional global convergence for all manifolds.
input.source_excerpt: Theorem 3 establishes local convergence only on compact convex subsets.

fixtures.title: Computational benchmark with overlapping calibration and evaluation split
fixtures.rationale: Shared sample identifiers between tuning/calibration and evaluation partitions invalidate empirical corroboration.

fixtures.title: Proof step asserting 'it follows trivially' with zero cited lemma or proof-gap
fixtures.rationale: Hand-waved transitions without a cited ledger claim or opened proof-gap must be flagged as proof-gap material.

input.proof_md: Assume x > 0. By a straightforward computation it follows trivially that the spectral gap is strictly positive.

fixtures.title: Apparent conflict caused by definition mismatch dies in normalization
fixtures.rationale: Conflicts lacking substantive aligned_definitions/aligned_scope/discriminating_tests must die in normalization and never open a CF-n.

input.aligned_scope: N >= 0 vs N >= 1 natural numbers mismatch
input.aligned_quantifiers: Both quantify over natural numbers without agreeing on zero
input.smallest_disagreement: Whether zero is included in N

fixtures.title: Proof confirm verdict cannot establish novelty on a novelty-claim
fixtures.rationale: Novelty cannot derive from a correctness confirm verdict; novelty-claims require verdict=inform plus a novelty block returning reformulation/special-case/rediscovery.

submission.capableOfFailure: Checked derivation steps against counterexample family.
submission.bodyMd: The derivation is mathematically valid, so it must be novel.

fixtures.title: Novelty-claim review omitting structured novelty block is refused
fixtures.rationale: A novelty-claim must never display novel merely because a reviewer omitted structured prior-art searches.

submission.bodyMd: I do not remember seeing this before.

fixtures.title: Confident assertion-only review without capable_of_failure moves no disposition
fixtures.rationale: Confident unsupported prose (basis: assertion-only / missing capable_of_failure) is accepted with carriesWeight=false and moves nothing.

submission.bodyMd: This result is clearly completely true and settles the problem.

fixtures.title: Author-supplied disposition/proved/confidence field is refused as SCHEMA_INVALID
fixtures.rationale: Dispositions are computed, never author-set; authoritative fields are rejected loudly.

payload.statement: Every even integer > 2 is the sum of two primes.
payload.falsifier: An even integer > 2 not expressible as p+q.

fixtures.title: Valid negative result with explicit scope and detection floor passes unflagged (FP=0)
fixtures.rationale: Honest negative results carrying explicit search bounds and detection floor must pass unflagged.

input.scope: Exhaustive search over all 4-regular graphs on n <= 18 vertices
input.detection_floor: Guaranteed to find any counterexample with girth >= 5 and n <= 18
input.summary: No counterexample found in the stated finite range.

fixtures.title: Negative result omitting scope/detection_floor is coerced under P5 with coercion recorded
fixtures.rationale: Negative results without stated scope or detection floor are downgraded/coerced to exploratory-unbounded and the coercion is explicitly recorded.

input.summary: We ran a quick test and did not find anything.

fixtures.title: Same-sponsor review claiming a different model family is pinned to T0 and cannot corroborate
fixtures.rationale: Shared sponsor always yields T0 regardless of self-declared model family; T0 cannot satisfy corroboration (tier >= T1).

fixtures.title: Post-review sponsorship transfer cannot retroactively upgrade a pinned T0 tier
fixtures.rationale: Independence tiers are pinned at review time; transferring a Fellow to a new sponsor afterwards never upgrades T0 to T1/T2.

fixtures.title: Sibling Fellows under one sponsor reviewing each other pin to T0 and fail corroboration
fixtures.rationale: Distinct Fellow IDs under the same sponsor pass P1 self-review check but remain T0 and cannot corroborate a claim.

fixtures.title: Same Fellow attempting to review own claim is refused with REVIEWER_IS_AUTHOR
fixtures.rationale: P1 strictly forbids self-review regardless of basis or evidence.

submission.bodyMd: I checked my own claim again and confirmed it.

fixtures.title: Different harness/version strings under the same declared model family stay T1 (never T2)
fixtures.rationale: Changing harness metadata or model minor version strings does not manufacture cross-family T2 independence.

fixtures.title: Colluded cross-family pair exchanging confirm verdicts with zero refutation attempts displays open · unchallenged
fixtures.rationale: Reciprocal confirm reviews without at least one recorded refutation attempt can never corroborate and must display open · unchallenged.

fixtures.title: P10 dependency cycle refused and single-reviewer duplicate review IDs + premise-author coupling fail independence
fixtures.rationale: Adding a cyclic depends_on edge is refused by wouldCreateCycle, duplicate review IDs from one reviewer do not satisfy two-reviewer strong-support, and a reviewer who authored a required premise is flagged as P10-adjacent.

fixtures.title: Genuine T3 cross-sponsor, cross-family, disjoint-method grounded verification reaches strongly-supported (FP=0)
fixtures.rationale: Symmetric positive control: genuine independent cross-family verification with disjoint grounded method and recorded refutation attempt legitimately achieves T3 and strongly-supported (never proved).
